subject: Pilot: marketplace connector integration & co-sell ops (CloudStrategix)
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice@cloudstrategix.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot request — Redwood connector for CloudStrategix marketplace

Hi Naomi —

We spoke at the conference last month and CloudStrategix is ready to run a short pilot to validate bundling Redwood as a managed inference connector in our marketplace. High level ask: a 6-week technical pilot to demonstrate provisioning, entitlement mapping (resale path), and a basic co-sell listing flow for AWS Private Offers.

Key things we care about:
- A quick install/demo (no on-prem required for pilot)
- Metering signals for usage/rightful attribution
- A short mutual action plan and a simple SOW/PO for procurement

Can you confirm Redwood has a playbook for sell-with / co-sell entitlements and if you'd be willing to run a pilot starting week of Aug 4? Happy to set a 30-minute call to scope.

Thanks —
Alice Gomez
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
CloudStrategix
alice@cloudstrategix.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice@cloudstrategix.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Redwood connector for CloudStrategix marketplace

Hi Alice —

Thanks for reaching out — wed love to run this pilot. Short answer: yes, we have an established sell-with playbook and a lightweight pilot SOW that covers provisioning, entitlement mapping, and co-sell readiness checks for AWS/Azure/GCP.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick scope call (30m) this week to align on success criteria and technical contacts
2) Well share a one-page SOW + pilot milestones (attach: RSW-CloudStrategix-Pilot-SOW-v1.pdf)
3) Procurement provides PO, we kick off a two-week prep sprint, then a four-week validation window

Ben and Grace are copied for velocity — Ben, can you flag any gating items on our side (metering hooks, entitlement mapping doc)? Grace, can you own the co-sell checklist and evidence pack?

I've attached the draft SOW as a starting point.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.example.com
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.example.com>, Alice Gomez <alice@cloudstrategix.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 13:28:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Redwood connector for CloudStrategix marketplace

Naomi / Alice —

Quick internal note on gating tech items and deliverables:
- Metering: we can emit per-tenant usage events to CloudStrategix via webhook and also push aggregated SKU metrics to their metering endpoint. Need CloudStrategix to confirm event schema; attached is a starter inventory CSV (integration-inventory.csv) showing required signal points.
- Entitlement mapping: well provide a mapping template; for AWS Private Offers we need buyer account id and the mapping table populated before pilot kickoff.
- Demo infra: can run on our hosted Dedicated pool (no extra infra from CloudStrategix) for the pilot.

Timeline suggestion (flexible):
Week 0: sign SOW + PO
Week 1-2: config, metering schema validation, entitlement mapping
Week 3-6: validation/partner QA + co-sell playbook dry run

Questions for CloudStrategix: can you confirm the expected AWS billing cadence and whether co-sell lead routing will be via your CRM or directly into our HubSpot?

Ben Carter
Solutions Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.example.com
From: Alice Gomez <alice@cloudstrategix.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cloudstrategix.com>, CloudStrategix Procurement <procurement@cloudstrategix.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Redwood connector for CloudStrategix marketplace

Thanks Ben — that timeline works for us. A couple clarifications:
- Procurement: weve attached a placeholder PO (CloudStrategix_PO_001.pdf) we can issue once SOW is final
- AWS billing: we plan to handle buyer billing via Private Offer and will reconcile usage weekly; we will need the mapping table populated before we activate the private offer.
- Lead routing: we prefer leads to come into our CRM (Salesforce) and have a webhook to push converted lead metadata back to Redwood for attribution.

We can do the kickoff Aug 4. Ive scheduled a 30-minute scoping call for Aug 5 at 10am PT — invite should come from my calendar.

On scope call Id like to walk the metering events CSV and agree on the minimal evidence pack youll provide for co-sell certification (SOC-qual checklist, integration test records, and a short demo recording).

Looking forward —
Alice Gomez
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships
CloudStrategix
From: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice@cloudstrategix.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.example.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Redwood connector for CloudStrategix marketplace

Alice / team —

Great — summary and immediate asks before the kickoff: 
- Naomi/Ben: finalize SOW (Ive uploaded draft to the Drive link below) and route to CloudStrategix procurement for signature.
- CloudStrategix: sign PO (CloudStrategix_PO_001.pdf) and share buyer account IDs for the entitlement mapping table.
- Ben: prepare the metering schema and the short evidence pack (SOC-qual checklist + example integration test results).
- Grace: prepare the co-sell checklist and plan a 20-min dry run in Week 4 to validate lead routing.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/1245789 | Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPilotDocs

If procurement is ready, well expect the signed SOW + PO by Aug 1 to hit the Aug 4 kickoff.

Thanks everyone — excited to run this with CloudStrategix.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.example.com
+1 650-555-0104
